signal_detail: U.S. Steel is investing $475 million in a new quench and tempering line at Fairfield Tubular Operations in Alabama, expected at full production in Q2 2029.

Planta Centenario Valladolid, a new Coca-Cola bottling plant in Valladolid, Yucatan operated by Bepensa Bebidas, was inaugurated on September 7 with an investment of more than 1,200 million pesos and more than 200 direct jobs.
